transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining on short notice. As you're aware, the incident-response team has completed its initial review of the unauthorized access to our customer-facing system, and the board's regular meeting is tomorrow. We need to determine whether an SEC Form 8-K filing is required and, if so, have it approved before that meeting. Currently, no 8-K has been drafted for this incident on our filing calendar. Under our normal pre-filing process, I need a final recommendation from each of you — cybersecurity, privacy, and investor relations — before I can authorize an external filing. I'd also note that the existing draft communications use general language about an investigation but do not specify the incident's regulatory classification, affected-account count, detailed operational impact, or ransom-demand treatment. Per our board-approved communications process, the final filing package must include a clear operational-continuity statement, omit ransom-demand details, and document board review before filing authorization. So let's work through this efficiently. Could each of you provide your assessment and recommendation?
